title: Cow eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="38" ry="6" fill="#3a7a3a"/>
  <!-- cow body -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="62" rx="26" ry="18" fill="#f0f0f0"/>
  <!-- cow spots -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="58" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#4a4a5a" transform="rotate(-15 40 58)"/>
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="68" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#4a4a5a" transform="rotate(10 55 68)"/>
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="52" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#4a4a5a"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="30" y="76" width="6" height="10" rx="2" fill="#e0e0e0"/>
  <rect x="44" y="77" width="6" height="10" rx="2" fill="#e0e0e0"/>
  <rect x="58" y="76" width="6" height="10" rx="2" fill="#e0e0e0"/>
  <rect x="62" y="77" width="6" height="10" rx="2" fill="#e0e0e0"/>
  <!-- hoofs -->
  <rect x="30" y="84" width="6" height="3" rx="1" fill="#c0a080"/>
  <rect x="44" y="85" width="6" height="3" rx="1" fill="#c0a080"/>
  <rect x="58" y="84" width="6" height="3" rx="1" fill="#c0a080"/>
  <rect x="62" y="85" width="6" height="3" rx="1" fill="#c0a080"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="50" rx="14" ry="13" fill="#f0f0f0"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="42" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#e0e0e0" transform="rotate(-30 60 42)"/>
  <ellipse cx="84" cy="42" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#e0e0e0" transform="rotate(30 84 42)"/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="38" rx="2.5" ry="4" fill="#e8d8a0" transform="rotate(-20 68 38)"/>
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="38" rx="2.5" ry="4" fill="#e8d8a0" transform="rotate(20 78 38)"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="67" cy="48" r="2.5" fill="#2a2a4a"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="48" r="2.5" fill="#2a2a4a"/>
  <circle cx="67.8" cy="47.2" r="0.9" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="78.8" cy="47.2" r="0.9" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="56" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#f0b0b0"/>
  <circle cx="71" cy="55" r="1.2" fill="#c07070"/>
  <circle cx="77" cy="55" r="1.2" fill="#c07070"/>
  <!-- mouth area -->
  <path d="M 71 59 Q 74 61 77 59" stroke="#c07070" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
  <!-- snack: green apple / grass treat -->
  <circle cx="84" cy="62" r="6" fill="#5cc85c"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="60" r="1.5" fill="#8ce88c"/>
  <path d="M 84 56 Q 86 53 88 54" stroke="#3a8a3a" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <!-- bite mark on snack -->
  <path d="M 78 62 Q 80 64 82 62 Q 80 66 78 65 Z" fill="#f0f0f0"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M 22 58 Q 14 54 16 64" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="16" cy="65" r="2.5" fill="#4a4a5a"/>
  <!-- bell -->
  <circle cx="70" cy="66" r="2.5" fill="#f0c040"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="68" r="0.8" fill="#e0a020"/>
</svg>
